build_standard_checkpoint_manager: build a StandardCheckpointManager to save and load training checkpoints on a file system
save_checkpoint: save a full training checkpoint including trainer, model, optimizer, and data reader state
save_model_only: save a model-only checkpoint without trainer, optimizer, or data reader state
load_model_state: load and restore model state from a checkpoint at a given step number
get_stale_step_numbers: get stale checkpoint step numbers based on keep_last_n, keep_best_n, and keep_every_n_steps policies
